---
title: "Political Socialization of Younger Generations: Participation, Beliefs, Attitudes and Knowledge"
subtitle: "RC42 session · XXI ISA World Congress of Sociology, Gwangju 2027"
date: 2027-07-04
author:
  - "Daniel Miranda"
  - "Janina Suppers"
categories: [Political Socialization, Youth]
---

The session examines how recent global transformations — including crises related to globalization, misinformation, and political polarization — shape younger generations' civic development. It invites scholarly contributions addressing: (1) the different agents of socialization and their role in acquiring knowledge, attitudes, beliefs, or behaviors relevant to the exercise of citizenship throughout life; (2) the social transformations and their impact on political socialization processes; and (3) the challenges that social shifts and generational differences put on current knowledge about political socialization processes.

**Organizer(s)/Chair(s):**

- Daniel Miranda, Department of Psychology, Faculty of Social Sciences, Universidad de Chile, Chile
- Janina Suppers, University of Waikato, New Zealand

**Host committee(s):** RC42 Social Psychology; RC34 Sociology of Youth
